tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen and the tab bar's surroundings.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, list groups, sheets, the tab bar and quick-action discs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Progress tracks, keypad press state, input fills inside panels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers inside panels and input borders. Never as a card outline.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, dates, helper text, inactive tab labels, on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Overlines, day headers and placeholder text on every surface (passes 4.5:1, use sparingly).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Horizon Green. Primary buttons, active tab, links, toggles on, focus ring. Text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: The home hero band, the app icon tile and the card face's dark stop.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chips, the active tab pill, secondary button fill, success banners.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-pressed fills.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Balance and titles on brand-deep.

tokens.name: on-hero-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and secondary text on brand-deep.

tokens.name: hero-chip
tokens.usage: Pills and icon buttons sitting on brand-deep.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Horizon Sun. The logo's sun, the card's sun, goal-reached moments and one highlight per screen at most. Never text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: sun-tint
tokens.usage: Background for warnings that are advice, not errors (scam tips, pending requests).

tokens.name: on-sun
tokens.usage: Text on sun fills.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Money in amounts (always with a + sign), completed status. Text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Completed status pill background.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Declines, errors, destructive actions. Always paired with an icon or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: negative-tint
tokens.usage: Declined pill and error banner background.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Close-match and over-budget states; text on sun-tint and surface-raised.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Pending status and neutral notices. Text on surface-raised.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Pending pill background.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Frozen-card overlay and the Freeze quick action when on.

tokens.name: on-frost
tokens.usage: Text and icons on frost.

tokens.name: card-from
tokens.usage: Debit card face, gradient start (top left).

tokens.name: card-to
tokens.usage: Debit card face, gradient end (bottom right).

tokens.name: card-chip-from
tokens.usage: Card chip gradient start.

tokens.name: card-chip-to
tokens.usage: Card chip gradient end.

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The balance on Home. Pence drop to 55% size. Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount-large
styles.usage: Amount keypad, transaction and payment-review headers.

styles.name: amount-row
styles.usage: Amounts at the end of list rows. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Flow step questions, sheet titles, success messages.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Your card is on its way.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels, merchant names.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row subtitles, helper text, tab labels (12px variant).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Day headers in the feed; always uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; between a title and its subtitle.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked panels; inside compact pills.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones; panel inner padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: List row horizontal padding; section header indent.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above a section header; flow screen padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a hero and the content below it.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Top padding on success and empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Merchant avatar tiles at 40px, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, option rows, pot chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and list groups.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (top corners) and the home hero's bottom corners.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The debit card face (ISO ratio 1.586).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, status pills, chips, tab indicator.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Notification banners and sheets only. Panels stay flat.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The debit card face.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Height of primary and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Merchant and person avatars in list rows.

tokens.name: size-quick-action
tokens.usage: Quick-action discs on Home and Card.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size; 20px in rows, 26px in quick actions.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Lucide stroke width at every size.
